objective: Improve worst generator-channel detection using only existing train/calibration embeddings; preserve human false-alert limits.
features: Frozen XLSR 256 + AASIST 160; unchanged audio preprocessing and VAD
selection: calibration only: require zero human alerts and no more low-scored synthetic than V3; rank by worst synthetic family-condition alert yield, overall synthetic alert yield, fewer low-scored synthetic, stronger regularization
testHandling: All currently cached test cases are known regression, never fresh. Do not tune candidates after inspecting regression predictions. A new source/reference recording check is required for replacing the runtime head.
regressionGate: For every existing cohort: no more human false alerts and no more low-scored synthetic than V3; for noisy Turbo in v4-fresh: at least one additional synthetic alert; total synthetic alerts must not decrease.
onFailure: Retain V3; keep rejected candidate results. Do not loosen thresholds or hide UNKNOWN/errors.
